subject.title: Orphaned lock files not cleared on gateway restart when PID matches current process

question: Should this issue remain the focused tracker for current-PID restart/recovery locks, or should the remaining live current-PID lock behavior move to a broader session-lock tracker after acknowledging the shipped partial fix?
rationale: Current main partially handles untracked self-owned locks, but reclaiming a lock still owned by the live gateway crosses transcript data-integrity and recovery policy boundaries that automation should not decide.

options.title: Keep Focused Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for same-PID restart/recovery lock semantics while narrower PRs handle compaction, delivery, and max-hold subcases.

options.title: Move Remaining Work
options.body: Close only after maintainers explicitly link the unresolved live current-PID behavior to a canonical open issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86538 and preserve this issue's field evidence there.

options.title: Declare Boot Slice Done
options.body: Treat the original boot-sweep slice as handled by the shipped partial fix and open a new narrower issue for runtime/recovery live current-PID leaks.

recommendation.title: Keep Focused Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for same-PID restart/recovery lock semantics while narrower PRs handle compaction, delivery, and max-hold subcases.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the affected session-lock and gateway startup code paths.
